description: This Java source file defines the MathUtils class, which provides miscellaneous static utility methods for mathematical operations, such as angle normalization, sign copying, hash calculations, and value checks within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: MathUtils
classes.description: A utility class with only static methods for mathematical operations, part of the Apache Commons Math library.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a hash code for a double value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two double values are equal according to Double's semantics.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a hash code for a double array.

methods.name: normalizeAngle
methods.description: Normalizes an angle to a 2π-wide interval around a specified center.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Reduces a value to the primary interval [0, |period|) based on a specified offset.

methods.name: copySign
methods.description: Returns a value with the magnitude of the first argument and the sign of the second argument for byte, short, int, and long types.

methods.name: checkFinite
methods.description: Checks if a double or array of doubles are finite numbers.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Checks if an object is not null, optionally with a custom message.
